title: Richer trial dummyData seed
summary: OdooTenantProvisioner now seeds categories, 14 DEMO SKUs, customers, ~32 paid orders over 14 days, 1–2 refunds, and leaves one POS session open. Unit tests pass on JDK 21. Live E2E against a fresh trial requires this pos-api build to be deployed (Dokploy) first.
postDeployAcceptance: Create a fresh trial with dummyData=true (unique slug).
Overview: non-zero Odoo net sales, sales count, items sold; trend bars; top products; category donut; refunds ≥ 1; open registers ≥ 1.
Stock: ≥ 12 DEMO products with varied remaining qty.
Register: open session ready; can sell remaining DEMO stock.
Delete the trial tenant after UAT; do not reuse harbour or demo production company.
notes: Existing tenants (e.g. harbour) are not backfilled; seed runs only at provision time.
Do not treat pre-deploy trial Overview zeros as a regression of this change.
